purpose: Final independent feasibility gate after 9 ms and 18 ms paired-radio contracts failed at RAN-alone
hardware: one A100-SXM4-40GB, MIG disabled, one MPS server, same physical GPU
ran_workload: two sequential valid 273-PRB PUSCH decodes per release with CRC and payload comparison
ai_workload: Aerial NeuralRx TensorRT FP16 CUDA Graph
conditions: uncontrolled NeuralRx at 100% MPS active threads
S0 with 6 ms end-to-end AI budget and 1 ms guard
S1 continuous NeuralRx at 80% MPS active threads and priority 0
decision_rule: If RAN-alone misses 21 ms, stop increasing the deadline from these data and treat RAN-tail removal as a prerequisite. Otherwise choose the highest-throughput protected condition with zero observed misses; still report this as statistical evidence, not unconditional proof.
